limitation_preservation.limitation_prompt: Separate recorded outcome and diagnostics from unique physical causation or a measured explanation of bad/slow motion. Explicit uncertainty OR clearly source-bounded observation wording is acceptable. Do not claim a measured delay mechanism, obstacle identity, inhibited applied motion or safety-speed policy from these records.

required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate that the recorded navigation failed/did not complete. Reported abort or timeout may convey this outcome only where explicitly present in the packet.
Communicate at least ONE of the listed supported diagnostic alternatives, preserving its source/state/temporal scope; do not require all alternatives or a unique physical cause.
